name: The Peach Orchard at Lake Fork
tagline: The Peach Orchard at Lake Fork
description: The Peach Orchard at Lake Fork is a family-run orchard in Yantis, TX. It grows Strawberries, Blackberries, Peaches, Plums, and Figs, with picking through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
